overview.zh: SP960.241-S是PULS PLANET目录明确列出的单相导轨电源。该记录对应独立订货型号，保留其专属输入输出、接线与安装边界，不从同系列相邻型号继承能力。
overview.en: SP960.241-S is an explicitly listed single-phase din-rail power supply in the PULS PLANET catalog.This record represents one ordering identity with its own input/output,wiring and installation limits,without inheriting ratings from adjacent models.

overview.zh: 额定电压：24 Vdc；输出功率：960 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：96 mm x 124 mm x 132 mm；连接方式：Screw terminals
overview.en: Nominal voltage:24 Vdc; Output power:960 W; Dimensions (WxHxD):96 mm x 124 mm x 132 mm; Connection method:Screw terminals

overview.zh: 可作为机器人控制柜及配套工业设备的供电、解耦或安装选型资料；并非已经在某款机器人上验证。单页参数已逐项保留，数据手册内部工况、曲线及配套设备兼容性仍需进一步核对。
overview.en: Relevant to power,decoupling or mounting selection for robot control cabinets and supporting industrial equipment,not proof of validation on a particular robot.Model-page fields are retained;internal datasheet conditions,curves and equipment compatibility still need review.

overview.en: SP960.241-SR is an explicitly listed single-phase din-rail power supply in the PULS PLANET catalog.This record represents one ordering identity with its own input/output,wiring and installation limits,without inheriting ratings from adjacent models.

overview.zh: 额定电压：24 Vdc；输出功率：960 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：96 mm x 124 mm x 132 mm；连接方式：Screw terminals

overview.zh: 可作为机器人控制柜及配套工业设备的供电、解耦或安装选型资料；并非已经在某款机器人上验证。单页参数已逐项保留，数据手册内部工况、曲线及配套设备兼容性仍需进一步核对。
overview.en: Relevant to power,decoupling or mounting selection for robot control cabinets and supporting industrial equipment,not proof of validation on a particular robot.Model-page fields are retained;internal datasheet conditions,curves and equipment compatibility still need review.

overview.zh: SP960.481-S是PULS PLANET目录明确列出的单相导轨电源。该记录对应独立订货型号，保留其专属输入输出、接线与安装边界，不从同系列相邻型号继承能力。
overview.en: SP960.481-S is an explicitly listed single-phase din-rail power supply in the PULS PLANET catalog.This record represents one ordering identity with its own input/output,wiring and installation limits,without inheriting ratings from adjacent models.

overview.zh: 额定电压：48 Vdc；输出功率：960 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：96 mm x 124 mm x 132 mm；连接方式：Screw terminals
overview.en: Nominal voltage:48 Vdc; Output power:960 W; Dimensions (WxHxD):96 mm x 124 mm x 132 mm; Connection method:Screw terminals

overview.zh: 可作为机器人控制柜及配套工业设备的供电、解耦或安装选型资料；并非已经在某款机器人上验证。单页参数已逐项保留，数据手册内部工况、曲线及配套设备兼容性仍需进一步核对。
overview.en: Relevant to power,decoupling or mounting selection for robot control cabinets and supporting industrial equipment,not proof of validation on a particular robot.Model-page fields are retained;internal datasheet conditions,curves and equipment compatibility still need review.

overview.zh: TP960.481是PULS PLANET目录明确列出的三相导轨电源。该记录对应独立订货型号，保留其专属输入输出、接线与安装边界，不从同系列相邻型号继承能力。
overview.en: TP960.481 is an explicitly listed three-phase din-rail power supply in the PULS PLANET catalog.This record represents one ordering identity with its own input/output,wiring and installation limits,without inheriting ratings from adjacent models.

overview.zh: 额定电压：48 Vdc；输出功率：960 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：79 mm x 124 mm x 136 mm；连接方式：Spring clamps
overview.en: Nominal voltage:48 Vdc; Output power:960 W; Dimensions (WxHxD):79 mm x 124 mm x 136 mm; Connection method:Spring clamps

overview.zh: 可作为机器人控制柜及配套工业设备的供电、解耦或安装选型资料；并非已经在某款机器人上验证。单页参数已逐项保留，数据手册内部工况、曲线及配套设备兼容性仍需进一步核对。
overview.en: Relevant to power,decoupling or mounting selection for robot control cabinets and supporting industrial equipment,not proof of validation on a particular robot.Model-page fields are retained;internal datasheet conditions,curves and equipment compatibility still need review.

overview.zh: PIC120.241D是PULS PIANO目录明确列出的单相导轨电源。该记录对应独立订货型号，保留其专属输入输出、接线与安装边界，不从同系列相邻型号继承能力。
overview.en: PIC120.241D is an explicitly listed single-phase din-rail power supply in the PULS PIANO catalog.This record represents one ordering identity with its own input/output,wiring and installation limits,without inheriting ratings from adjacent models.

overview.zh: 额定电压：24 Vdc；输出功率：120 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：39 mm x 124 mm x 124 mm；连接方式：Screw terminals
overview.en: Nominal voltage:24 Vdc; Output power:120 W; Dimensions (WxHxD):39 mm x 124 mm x 124 mm; Connection method:Screw terminals

overview.zh: 可作为机器人控制柜及配套工业设备的供电、解耦或安装选型资料；并非已经在某款机器人上验证。单页参数已逐项保留，数据手册内部工况、曲线及配套设备兼容性仍需进一步核对。
overview.en: Relevant to power,decoupling or mounting selection for robot control cabinets and supporting industrial equipment,not proof of validation on a particular robot.Model-page fields are retained;internal datasheet conditions,curves and equipment compatibility still need review.

overview.zh: PIC120.242C是PULS PIANO目录明确列出的单相导轨电源。该记录对应独立订货型号，保留其专属输入输出、接线与安装边界，不从同系列相邻型号继承能力。
overview.en: PIC120.242C is an explicitly listed single-phase din-rail power supply in the PULS PIANO catalog.This record represents one ordering identity with its own input/output,wiring and installation limits,without inheriting ratings from adjacent models.

overview.zh: 额定电压：24 Vdc；输出功率：120 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：39 mm x 124 mm x 124 mm；连接方式：Screw terminals
overview.en: Nominal voltage:24 Vdc; Output power:120 W; Dimensions (WxHxD):39 mm x 124 mm x 124 mm; Connection method:Screw terminals

overview.zh: 可作为机器人控制柜及配套工业设备的供电、解耦或安装选型资料；并非已经在某款机器人上验证。单页参数已逐项保留，数据手册内部工况、曲线及配套设备兼容性仍需进一步核对。
overview.en: Relevant to power,decoupling or mounting selection for robot control cabinets and supporting industrial equipment,not proof of validation on a particular robot.Model-page fields are retained;internal datasheet conditions,curves and equipment compatibility still need review.

overview.zh: PIC240.241C是PULS PIANO目录明确列出的单相导轨电源。该记录对应独立订货型号，保留其专属输入输出、接线与安装边界，不从同系列相邻型号继承能力。
overview.en: PIC240.241C is an explicitly listed single-phase din-rail power supply in the PULS PIANO catalog.This record represents one ordering identity with its own input/output,wiring and installation limits,without inheriting ratings from adjacent models.

overview.zh: 额定电压：24 Vdc；输出功率：240 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：49 mm x 124 mm x 124 mm；连接方式：Screw terminals
overview.en: Nominal voltage:24 Vdc; Output power:240 W; Dimensions (WxHxD):49 mm x 124 mm x 124 mm; Connection method:Screw terminals

overview.zh: 可作为机器人控制柜及配套工业设备的供电、解耦或安装选型资料；并非已经在某款机器人上验证。单页参数已逐项保留，数据手册内部工况、曲线及配套设备兼容性仍需进一步核对。
overview.en: Relevant to power,decoupling or mounting selection for robot control cabinets and supporting industrial equipment,not proof of validation on a particular robot.Model-page fields are retained;internal datasheet conditions,curves and equipment compatibility still need review.

overview.zh: PIC480.241C是PULS PIANO目录明确列出的单相导轨电源。该记录对应独立订货型号，保留其专属输入输出、接线与安装边界，不从同系列相邻型号继承能力。
overview.en: PIC480.241C is an explicitly listed single-phase din-rail power supply in the PULS PIANO catalog.This record represents one ordering identity with its own input/output,wiring and installation limits,without inheriting ratings from adjacent models.

overview.zh: 额定电压：24 Vdc；输出功率：480 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：49 mm x 124 mm x 124 mm；连接方式：Screw terminals
overview.en: Nominal voltage:24 Vdc; Output power:480 W; Dimensions (WxHxD):49 mm x 124 mm x 124 mm; Connection method:Screw terminals

overview.zh: 可作为机器人控制柜及配套工业设备的供电、解耦或安装选型资料；并非已经在某款机器人上验证。单页参数已逐项保留，数据手册内部工况、曲线及配套设备兼容性仍需进一步核对。
overview.en: Relevant to power,decoupling or mounting selection for robot control cabinets and supporting industrial equipment,not proof of validation on a particular robot.Model-page fields are retained;internal datasheet conditions,curves and equipment compatibility still need review.

overview.zh: 额定电压：24 Vdc；输出功率：480 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：59 mm x 124 mm x 127 mm；连接方式：Screw terminals

overview.zh: PIC480.481D是PULS PIANO目录明确列出的单相导轨电源。该记录对应独立订货型号，保留其专属输入输出、接线与安装边界，不从同系列相邻型号继承能力。
overview.en: PIC480.481D is an explicitly listed single-phase din-rail power supply in the PULS PIANO catalog.This record represents one ordering identity with its own input/output,wiring and installation limits,without inheriting ratings from adjacent models.

overview.zh: 额定电压：48 Vdc；输出功率：480 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：59 mm x 124 mm x 127 mm；连接方式：Screw terminals
overview.en: Nominal voltage:48 Vdc; Output power:480 W; Dimensions (WxHxD):59 mm x 124 mm x 127 mm; Connection method:Screw terminals

overview.zh: 可作为机器人控制柜及配套工业设备的供电、解耦或安装选型资料；并非已经在某款机器人上验证。单页参数已逐项保留，数据手册内部工况、曲线及配套设备兼容性仍需进一步核对。
overview.en: Relevant to power,decoupling or mounting selection for robot control cabinets and supporting industrial equipment,not proof of validation on a particular robot.Model-page fields are retained;internal datasheet conditions,curves and equipment compatibility still need review.

overview.zh: PIM36.241是PULS PIANO目录明确列出的单相导轨电源。该记录对应独立订货型号，保留其专属输入输出、接线与安装边界，不从同系列相邻型号继承能力。
overview.en: PIM36.241 is an explicitly listed single-phase din-rail power supply in the PULS PIANO catalog.This record represents one ordering identity with its own input/output,wiring and installation limits,without inheriting ratings from adjacent models.

overview.zh: 额定电压：24 Vdc；输出功率：36 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：22.5 mm x 90 mm x 91 mm；连接方式：Push-in clamps
overview.en: Nominal voltage:24 Vdc; Output power:36 W; Dimensions (WxHxD):22.5 mm x 90 mm x 91 mm; Connection method:Push-in clamps

overview.zh: 可作为机器人控制柜及配套工业设备的供电、解耦或安装选型资料；并非已经在某款机器人上验证。单页参数已逐项保留，数据手册内部工况、曲线及配套设备兼容性仍需进一步核对。
overview.en: Relevant to power,decoupling or mounting selection for robot control cabinets and supporting industrial equipment,not proof of validation on a particular robot.Model-page fields are retained;internal datasheet conditions,curves and equipment compatibility still need review.

overview.zh: PIM60.121是PULS PIANO目录明确列出的单相导轨电源。该记录对应独立订货型号，保留其专属输入输出、接线与安装边界，不从同系列相邻型号继承能力。
overview.en: PIM60.121 is an explicitly listed single-phase din-rail power supply in the PULS PIANO catalog.This record represents one ordering identity with its own input/output,wiring and installation limits,without inheriting ratings from adjacent models.

overview.zh: 额定电压：12 Vdc；输出功率：60 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：36 mm x 90 mm x 91 mm；连接方式：Push-in clamps
overview.en: Nominal voltage:12 Vdc; Output power:60 W; Dimensions (WxHxD):36 mm x 90 mm x 91 mm; Connection method:Push-in clamps

overview.zh: 可作为机器人控制柜及配套工业设备的供电、解耦或安装选型资料；并非已经在某款机器人上验证。单页参数已逐项保留，数据手册内部工况、曲线及配套设备兼容性仍需进一步核对。
overview.en: Relevant to power,decoupling or mounting selection for robot control cabinets and supporting industrial equipment,not proof of validation on a particular robot.Model-page fields are retained;internal datasheet conditions,curves and equipment compatibility still need review.

overview.zh: 可作为机器人控制柜及配套工业设备的供电、解耦或安装选型资料；并非已经在某款机器人上验证。单页参数已逐项保留，数据手册内部工况、曲线及配套设备兼容性仍需进一步核对。

overview.zh: PIM60.245是PULS PIANO目录明确列出的单相导轨电源。该记录对应独立订货型号，保留其专属输入输出、接线与安装边界，不从同系列相邻型号继承能力。
overview.en: PIM60.245 is an explicitly listed single-phase din-rail power supply in the PULS PIANO catalog.This record represents one ordering identity with its own input/output,wiring and installation limits,without inheriting ratings from adjacent models.

overview.zh: 额定电压：24 Vdc；输出功率：60 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：36 mm x 90 mm x 91 mm；连接方式：Screw terminals
overview.en: Nominal voltage:24 Vdc; Output power:60 W; Dimensions (WxHxD):36 mm x 90 mm x 91 mm; Connection method:Screw terminals

overview.zh: 可作为机器人控制柜及配套工业设备的供电、解耦或安装选型资料；并非已经在某款机器人上验证。单页参数已逐项保留，数据手册内部工况、曲线及配套设备兼容性仍需进一步核对。
overview.en: Relevant to power,decoupling or mounting selection for robot control cabinets and supporting industrial equipment,not proof of validation on a particular robot.Model-page fields are retained;internal datasheet conditions,curves and equipment compatibility still need review.

overview.zh: 额定电压：24 Vdc；输出功率：90 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：36 mm x 90 mm x 91 mm；连接方式：Screw terminals

overview.zh: 可作为机器人控制柜及配套工业设备的供电、解耦或安装选型资料；并非已经在某款机器人上验证。单页参数已逐项保留，数据手册内部工况、曲线及配套设备兼容性仍需进一步核对。

overview.zh: PIRD20.241是PULS PIANO目录明确列出的二极管冗余模块。该记录对应独立订货型号，保留其专属输入输出、接线与安装边界，不从同系列相邻型号继承能力。
overview.en: PIRD20.241 is an explicitly listed diode redundancy module in the PULS PIANO catalog.This record represents one ordering identity with its own input/output,wiring and installation limits,without inheriting ratings from adjacent models.

overview.zh: 尺寸（宽×高×深）：39 mm x 124 mm x 124 mm；连接方式：Screw terminals
overview.en: Dimensions (WxHxD):39 mm x 124 mm x 124 mm; Connection method:Screw terminals

overview.zh: 可作为机器人控制柜及配套工业设备的供电、解耦或安装选型资料；并非已经在某款机器人上验证。单页参数已逐项保留，数据手册内部工况、曲线及配套设备兼容性仍需进一步核对。
overview.en: Relevant to power,decoupling or mounting selection for robot control cabinets and supporting industrial equipment,not proof of validation on a particular robot.Model-page fields are retained;internal datasheet conditions,curves and equipment compatibility still need review.

overview.en: ML15.051 is an explicitly listed single-phase din-rail power supply in the PULS MiniLine catalog.This record represents one ordering identity with its own input/output,wiring and installation limits,without inheriting ratings from adjacent models.

overview.zh: 额定电压：5 Vdc；输出功率：15 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：23 mm x 75 mm x 91 mm；连接方式：Screw terminals

overview.zh: 可作为机器人控制柜及配套工业设备的供电、解耦或安装选型资料；并非已经在某款机器人上验证。单页参数已逐项保留，数据手册内部工况、曲线及配套设备兼容性仍需进一步核对。

overview.zh: 额定电压：12 Vdc；输出功率：15 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：23 mm x 75 mm x 91 mm；连接方式：Screw terminals

overview.zh: 额定电压：24 Vdc；输出功率：30 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：45 mm x 75 mm x 91 mm；连接方式：Spring clamps

overview.zh: 可作为机器人控制柜及配套工业设备的供电、解耦或安装选型资料；并非已经在某款机器人上验证。单页参数已逐项保留，数据手册内部工况、曲线及配套设备兼容性仍需进一步核对。

overview.zh: ML50.100是PULS MiniLine目录明确列出的单相导轨电源。该记录对应独立订货型号，保留其专属输入输出、接线与安装边界，不从同系列相邻型号继承能力。
overview.en: ML50.100 is an explicitly listed single-phase din-rail power supply in the PULS MiniLine catalog.This record represents one ordering identity with its own input/output,wiring and installation limits,without inheriting ratings from adjacent models.

overview.zh: 额定电压：24 Vdc；输出功率：50 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：45 mm x 75 mm x 91 mm；连接方式：Spring clamps
overview.en: Nominal voltage:24 Vdc; Output power:50 W; Dimensions (WxHxD):45 mm x 75 mm x 91 mm; Connection method:Spring clamps

overview.zh: 可作为机器人控制柜及配套工业设备的供电、解耦或安装选型资料；并非已经在某款机器人上验证。单页参数已逐项保留，数据手册内部工况、曲线及配套设备兼容性仍需进一步核对。
overview.en: Relevant to power,decoupling or mounting selection for robot control cabinets and supporting industrial equipment,not proof of validation on a particular robot.Model-page fields are retained;internal datasheet conditions,curves and equipment compatibility still need review.

overview.zh: ML50.101是PULS MiniLine目录明确列出的单相导轨电源。该记录对应独立订货型号，保留其专属输入输出、接线与安装边界，不从同系列相邻型号继承能力。
overview.en: ML50.101 is an explicitly listed single-phase din-rail power supply in the PULS MiniLine catalog.This record represents one ordering identity with its own input/output,wiring and installation limits,without inheriting ratings from adjacent models.

overview.zh: 额定电压：24 Vdc；输出功率：50 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：45 mm x 75 mm x 91 mm；连接方式：Spring clamps
overview.en: Nominal voltage:24 Vdc; Output power:50 W; Dimensions (WxHxD):45 mm x 75 mm x 91 mm; Connection method:Spring clamps

overview.zh: 可作为机器人控制柜及配套工业设备的供电、解耦或安装选型资料；并非已经在某款机器人上验证。单页参数已逐项保留，数据手册内部工况、曲线及配套设备兼容性仍需进一步核对。
overview.en: Relevant to power,decoupling or mounting selection for robot control cabinets and supporting industrial equipment,not proof of validation on a particular robot.Model-page fields are retained;internal datasheet conditions,curves and equipment compatibility still need review.

overview.zh: ML50.102是PULS MiniLine目录明确列出的单相导轨电源。该记录对应独立订货型号，保留其专属输入输出、接线与安装边界，不从同系列相邻型号继承能力。
overview.en: ML50.102 is an explicitly listed single-phase din-rail power supply in the PULS MiniLine catalog.This record represents one ordering identity with its own input/output,wiring and installation limits,without inheriting ratings from adjacent models.

overview.zh: 额定电压：12 Vdc；输出功率：50 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：45 mm x 75 mm x 91 mm；连接方式：Spring clamps
overview.en: Nominal voltage:12 Vdc; Output power:50 W; Dimensions (WxHxD):45 mm x 75 mm x 91 mm; Connection method:Spring clamps

overview.zh: 可作为机器人控制柜及配套工业设备的供电、解耦或安装选型资料；并非已经在某款机器人上验证。单页参数已逐项保留，数据手册内部工况、曲线及配套设备兼容性仍需进一步核对。

overview.zh: ML50.105是PULS MiniLine目录明确列出的单相导轨电源。该记录对应独立订货型号，保留其专属输入输出、接线与安装边界，不从同系列相邻型号继承能力。
overview.en: ML50.105 is an explicitly listed single-phase din-rail power supply in the PULS MiniLine catalog.This record represents one ordering identity with its own input/output,wiring and installation limits,without inheriting ratings from adjacent models.

overview.zh: 额定电压：48 Vdc；输出功率：50 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：45 mm x 75 mm x 91 mm；连接方式：Spring clamps
overview.en: Nominal voltage:48 Vdc; Output power:50 W; Dimensions (WxHxD):45 mm x 75 mm x 91 mm; Connection method:Spring clamps

overview.zh: 可作为机器人控制柜及配套工业设备的供电、解耦或安装选型资料；并非已经在某款机器人上验证。单页参数已逐项保留，数据手册内部工况、曲线及配套设备兼容性仍需进一步核对。
overview.en: Relevant to power,decoupling or mounting selection for robot control cabinets and supporting industrial equipment,not proof of validation on a particular robot.Model-page fields are retained;internal datasheet conditions,curves and equipment compatibility still need review.

overview.zh: 额定电压：24 Vdc；输出功率：50 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：45 mm x 75 mm x 91 mm；连接方式：Spring clamps

overview.zh: ML50.111是PULS MiniLine目录明确列出的单相导轨电源。该记录对应独立订货型号，保留其专属输入输出、接线与安装边界，不从同系列相邻型号继承能力。
overview.en: ML50.111 is an explicitly listed single-phase din-rail power supply in the PULS MiniLine catalog.This record represents one ordering identity with its own input/output,wiring and installation limits,without inheriting ratings from adjacent models.

overview.zh: 额定电压：24 Vdc；输出功率：50 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：45 mm x 75 mm x 98 mm；连接方式：Plug connector
overview.en: Nominal voltage:24 Vdc; Output power:50 W; Dimensions (WxHxD):45 mm x 75 mm x 98 mm; Connection method:Plug connector

overview.zh: 可作为机器人控制柜及配套工业设备的供电、解耦或安装选型资料；并非已经在某款机器人上验证。单页参数已逐项保留，数据手册内部工况、曲线及配套设备兼容性仍需进一步核对。
overview.en: Relevant to power,decoupling or mounting selection for robot control cabinets and supporting industrial equipment,not proof of validation on a particular robot.Model-page fields are retained;internal datasheet conditions,curves and equipment compatibility still need review.

overview.zh: 额定电压：12 Vdc；输出功率：54 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：45 mm x 75 mm x 91 mm；连接方式：Screw terminals

overview.zh: 可作为机器人控制柜及配套工业设备的供电、解耦或安装选型资料；并非已经在某款机器人上验证。单页参数已逐项保留，数据手册内部工况、曲线及配套设备兼容性仍需进一步核对。

overview.zh: ML60.241是PULS MiniLine目录明确列出的单相导轨电源。该记录对应独立订货型号，保留其专属输入输出、接线与安装边界，不从同系列相邻型号继承能力。
overview.en: ML60.241 is an explicitly listed single-phase din-rail power supply in the PULS MiniLine catalog.This record represents one ordering identity with its own input/output,wiring and installation limits,without inheriting ratings from adjacent models.

overview.zh: 额定电压：24 Vdc；输出功率：60 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：45 mm x 75 mm x 91 mm；连接方式：Screw terminals
overview.en: Nominal voltage:24 Vdc; Output power:60 W; Dimensions (WxHxD):45 mm x 75 mm x 91 mm; Connection method:Screw terminals

overview.zh: 可作为机器人控制柜及配套工业设备的供电、解耦或安装选型资料；并非已经在某款机器人上验证。单页参数已逐项保留，数据手册内部工况、曲线及配套设备兼容性仍需进一步核对。
overview.en: Relevant to power,decoupling or mounting selection for robot control cabinets and supporting industrial equipment,not proof of validation on a particular robot.Model-page fields are retained;internal datasheet conditions,curves and equipment compatibility still need review.

overview.zh: ML60.242是PULS MiniLine目录明确列出的单相导轨电源。该记录对应独立订货型号，保留其专属输入输出、接线与安装边界，不从同系列相邻型号继承能力。
overview.en: ML60.242 is an explicitly listed single-phase din-rail power supply in the PULS MiniLine catalog.This record represents one ordering identity with its own input/output,wiring and installation limits,without inheriting ratings from adjacent models.

overview.zh: 额定电压：24 Vdc；输出功率：60 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：45 mm x 75 mm x 91 mm；连接方式：Screw terminals
overview.en: Nominal voltage:24 Vdc; Output power:60 W; Dimensions (WxHxD):45 mm x 75 mm x 91 mm; Connection method:Screw terminals

overview.zh: 可作为机器人控制柜及配套工业设备的供电、解耦或安装选型资料；并非已经在某款机器人上验证。单页参数已逐项保留，数据手册内部工况、曲线及配套设备兼容性仍需进一步核对。
overview.en: Relevant to power,decoupling or mounting selection for robot control cabinets and supporting industrial equipment,not proof of validation on a particular robot.Model-page fields are retained;internal datasheet conditions,curves and equipment compatibility still need review.

overview.zh: ML95.100是PULS MiniLine目录明确列出的单相导轨电源。该记录对应独立订货型号，保留其专属输入输出、接线与安装边界，不从同系列相邻型号继承能力。
overview.en: ML95.100 is an explicitly listed single-phase din-rail power supply in the PULS MiniLine catalog.This record represents one ordering identity with its own input/output,wiring and installation limits,without inheriting ratings from adjacent models.

overview.zh: 额定电压：24 Vdc；输出功率：95 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：73 mm x 75 mm x 103 mm；连接方式：Spring clamps
overview.en: Nominal voltage:24 Vdc; Output power:95 W; Dimensions (WxHxD):73 mm x 75 mm x 103 mm; Connection method:Spring clamps

overview.zh: 可作为机器人控制柜及配套工业设备的供电、解耦或安装选型资料；并非已经在某款机器人上验证。单页参数已逐项保留，数据手册内部工况、曲线及配套设备兼容性仍需进一步核对。
overview.en: Relevant to power,decoupling or mounting selection for robot control cabinets and supporting industrial equipment,not proof of validation on a particular robot.Model-page fields are retained;internal datasheet conditions,curves and equipment compatibility still need review.

overview.zh: ML100.100是PULS MiniLine目录明确列出的单相导轨电源。该记录对应独立订货型号，保留其专属输入输出、接线与安装边界，不从同系列相邻型号继承能力。
overview.en: ML100.100 is an explicitly listed single-phase din-rail power supply in the PULS MiniLine catalog.This record represents one ordering identity with its own input/output,wiring and installation limits,without inheriting ratings from adjacent models.

overview.zh: 额定电压：24 Vdc；输出功率：100 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：73 mm x 75 mm x 103 mm；连接方式：Spring clamps
overview.en: Nominal voltage:24 Vdc; Output power:100 W; Dimensions (WxHxD):73 mm x 75 mm x 103 mm; Connection method:Spring clamps

overview.zh: 可作为机器人控制柜及配套工业设备的供电、解耦或安装选型资料；并非已经在某款机器人上验证。单页参数已逐项保留，数据手册内部工况、曲线及配套设备兼容性仍需进一步核对。
overview.en: Relevant to power,decoupling or mounting selection for robot control cabinets and supporting industrial equipment,not proof of validation on a particular robot.Model-page fields are retained;internal datasheet conditions,curves and equipment compatibility still need review.

overview.zh: ML100.102是PULS MiniLine目录明确列出的单相导轨电源。该记录对应独立订货型号，保留其专属输入输出、接线与安装边界，不从同系列相邻型号继承能力。
overview.en: ML100.102 is an explicitly listed single-phase din-rail power supply in the PULS MiniLine catalog.This record represents one ordering identity with its own input/output,wiring and installation limits,without inheriting ratings from adjacent models.

overview.zh: 额定电压：12 Vdc；输出功率：90 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：73 mm x 75 mm x 103 mm；连接方式：Spring clamps
overview.en: Nominal voltage:12 Vdc; Output power:90 W; Dimensions (WxHxD):73 mm x 75 mm x 103 mm; Connection method:Spring clamps

overview.zh: 可作为机器人控制柜及配套工业设备的供电、解耦或安装选型资料；并非已经在某款机器人上验证。单页参数已逐项保留，数据手册内部工况、曲线及配套设备兼容性仍需进一步核对。
overview.en: Relevant to power,decoupling or mounting selection for robot control cabinets and supporting industrial equipment,not proof of validation on a particular robot.Model-page fields are retained;internal datasheet conditions,curves and equipment compatibility still need review.

overview.zh: ML90.200是PULS MiniLine目录明确列出的三相导轨电源。该记录对应独立订货型号，保留其专属输入输出、接线与安装边界，不从同系列相邻型号继承能力。
overview.en: ML90.200 is an explicitly listed three-phase din-rail power supply in the PULS MiniLine catalog.This record represents one ordering identity with its own input/output,wiring and installation limits,without inheriting ratings from adjacent models.

overview.zh: 额定电压：24 Vdc；输出功率：90 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：73 mm x 75 mm x 103 mm；连接方式：Spring clamps
overview.en: Nominal voltage:24 Vdc; Output power:90 W; Dimensions (WxHxD):73 mm x 75 mm x 103 mm; Connection method:Spring clamps

overview.zh: 可作为机器人控制柜及配套工业设备的供电、解耦或安装选型资料；并非已经在某款机器人上验证。单页参数已逐项保留，数据手册内部工况、曲线及配套设备兼容性仍需进一步核对。
overview.en: Relevant to power,decoupling or mounting selection for robot control cabinets and supporting industrial equipment,not proof of validation on a particular robot.Model-page fields are retained;internal datasheet conditions,curves and equipment compatibility still need review.

overview.zh: ML100.200是PULS MiniLine目录明确列出的三相导轨电源。该记录对应独立订货型号，保留其专属输入输出、接线与安装边界，不从同系列相邻型号继承能力。
overview.en: ML100.200 is an explicitly listed three-phase din-rail power supply in the PULS MiniLine catalog.This record represents one ordering identity with its own input/output,wiring and installation limits,without inheriting ratings from adjacent models.

overview.zh: 额定电压：24 Vdc；输出功率：100 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：73 mm x 75 mm x 103 mm；连接方式：Spring clamps
overview.en: Nominal voltage:24 Vdc; Output power:100 W; Dimensions (WxHxD):73 mm x 75 mm x 103 mm; Connection method:Spring clamps

overview.zh: 可作为机器人控制柜及配套工业设备的供电、解耦或安装选型资料；并非已经在某款机器人上验证。单页参数已逐项保留，数据手册内部工况、曲线及配套设备兼容性仍需进一步核对。
overview.en: Relevant to power,decoupling or mounting selection for robot control cabinets and supporting industrial equipment,not proof of validation on a particular robot.Model-page fields are retained;internal datasheet conditions,curves and equipment compatibility still need review.

overview.zh: MLY02.100是PULS MiniLine目录明确列出的二极管冗余模块。该记录对应独立订货型号，保留其专属输入输出、接线与安装边界，不从同系列相邻型号继承能力。
overview.en: MLY02.100 is an explicitly listed diode redundancy module in the PULS MiniLine catalog.This record represents one ordering identity with its own input/output,wiring and installation limits,without inheriting ratings from adjacent models.

overview.zh: 尺寸（宽×高×深）：45 mm x 75 mm x 91 mm；连接方式：Spring clamps
overview.en: Dimensions (WxHxD):45 mm x 75 mm x 91 mm; Connection method:Spring clamps

overview.zh: 可作为机器人控制柜及配套工业设备的供电、解耦或安装选型资料；并非已经在某款机器人上验证。单页参数已逐项保留，数据手册内部工况、曲线及配套设备兼容性仍需进一步核对。
overview.en: Relevant to power,decoupling or mounting selection for robot control cabinets and supporting industrial equipment,not proof of validation on a particular robot.Model-page fields are retained;internal datasheet conditions,curves and equipment compatibility still need review.
